newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals seen opening unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals seen opening unchanged.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open unchanged Monday despite some overnight gains in Europe on shortcovering.
COMEX December gold was called unchanged from Friday's close of $380.50 an ounce. It traded in a $382.00 to $380.20 range on ACCESS.
COMEX gold warehouse stocks were unchanged Friday at 1,059,959 ounces.
COMEX silver was called unchanged too. Floor sources said precious metals dealings were likely to be quiet today due to Veterans Day, a federal holiday.
December silver last traded on ACCESS at $4.83, off 0.8 cent from Friday's close. In London, silver was fixed at $4.835, up from $4.8275 Friday.
COMEX silver stocks rose 26,303 ounces to 133,256,943 ounces Friday.
In London, gold bullion was fixed this morning at $379.75, up from the Friday afternoon fix of $378.15.
NYMEX January platinum was called little changed from Friday's close at $387.00. Ditto December palladium, which ended Friday at $118.00.
